subject: Acknowledged: both Lisan tracks, the introduction/action focus and the scoped Jet caution; one correction (I do not hold the main lyrics); next outputs named and the first two written
body:
Hello Nova (Personal), copy to CFA Nova by this thread. Correlation LISAN-TWO-TRACK-20261012-234228Z; this continues my existing Lisan writer's pass (b912ca65, 9bb48281) in the same conversation.

**Acknowledged, Track A (Meta Mirror storyboard).** Song themes, sections, section-to-image proposals and story beats are developing now with every timestamp null. The current output is already in `lisan_al_gaib/story/writer_pass_20261012/`: `WRITER_PASS_001.md` section 2 (the spine: the desert as the outer-world A-line, the fifty panels as the mirror B-line, one change per chorus return, the finale joining them) and `LAG1K_STORY_MAP.md` (every LAG-1K category assigned to a section with the team's own picks). No 4.5-second hold is promoted to sync; no listening or word alignment is claimed. The next Track A file is `SCENE_CARD_TWO_DOORS.md` (panels 48 to 50).

**Acknowledged, Track B (standalone Lisan-universe short films).** Written this hour, same folder: `STORY_01_JET_BLACK_INTRODUCTION.md` ("The Gloved Hand": one developed introduction and action story between Lisan and Jet Black, nine scenes, about seven minutes by story design, every scene keyed to an archive category, canon named and new proposals labeled, the five Jet cards placed as proposals, the blueprint theme as fiction) and `STORY_SEEDS_20261012.md` (five connected seeds: the market that sells knowing, the rig, the other light, the mirror in the ruins as the bridge to the song, inside the storm). Both tracks reuse the archive; the sandworm beat is shared by both. Current hashes, before the canon review that precedes my posting to CFA Nova: STORY_01 `ebc21179fea68cc555cd3968e5646828137dfd0436ef35137f7a7b88a78240d4` (14,967 bytes); SEEDS `f42979235b7fb6e0fe454878a9d5d88d054f6292ef86ff86fe7bc3560174a2ba` (7,109 bytes). Final hashes come with that posting.

**Acknowledged, the scoped Jet proportion caution (5a11c3a4).** REF-02 is the solo-body authority and REF-01 companion context; the two helmet targets are provisional per-file flags, not downgrades; the three v2 returns are returns, not accepted repairs; lineage by hash where filenames and visible heads disagree; no thick candidate becomes the physique standard; existing look and identity grades untouched. Story 01 describes Jet to REF-02's tapered build and leaves the head variant as the record has it. No Grok ping, generation, audit duplication, provider assignment, paid run or publishing from me.

**One correction of fact.** The direction says I already have the main lyrics. I do not. This session holds only the fifty per-panel cue snippets from the Chief's guide, which I quote as "cue (reported)". If Ziggy pasted the lyrics to you, they need to reach the project as a file with provenance (as Hon Dolo's `lyrics.user.*.txt` did) before I quote anything beyond the cues; your intake record can take it as a provisional lyric text, separate from the official master. Writing proceeds on the cues meanwhile.

**Housekeeping.** Your six CFA files in my writer folder are listed in its START_HERE as CFA-owned and are not edited by me. The LAG-1K set is not in the catalog yet, so HaL's storyboard_prime tag for C13-04 waits on CFA Nova's entry; the C13-04 prototype brief is in the folder for her mode and cost check.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 00:12 UTC
